Pakistan Fee Voucher Scam Halts Exam Results for 409 Students

A fee voucher scam in Sahiwal, Pakistan, has led to the freezing of matriculation examination results for 409 candidates. The issue stems from administrative decay within the examination system. This incident has directly impacted the academic future of a significant number of students.
